pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: src/components/org/shell/OrgTabChunks.tsx:55 Switching tabs remounts the overview subtree and replays its entrance animation, discarding local form state instead of providing warm return.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/db/org-nav-counts.ts:47 The personal rail receives follow-up counts from personal-org scans, whereas PersonalBacklog displays public-corpus recommendations merged with personal overlays; the badge derivation does not count the work its destination displays.

src/components/org/shell/OrgTabNav.tsx:99 Personal-workspace restrictions filter the rail inline, but OrgDashboardPage validates only the tab vocabulary; a hidden Teams destination still renders through ?tab=teams without consulting PERSONAL_TAB_IDS.

src/components/org/shell/OrgTabChunks.tsx:55 Re-keying the whole panel forces teardown and entrance choreography on every return; PersonalWatchControls keeps its input in component-local useState without restoration.
src/components/ui/SectionRailNav.tsx:143 The second level renders only the selected group's stable destinations; changing location resets the temporary group preview.

src/lib/org/orgTabs.ts:457 Route availability is manually enumerated separately from ORG_TAB_IDS and ORG_NAV_GROUPS, so adding a destination requires synchronizing parallel lists rather than deriving consumers from one registry.

src/components/org/shared/useRunnerNotifier.ts:68 The shell-resident notification worker converts unsuccessful polling responses into null without reporting degraded health, making a failing worker indistinguishable from a quiet one.
